cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(buffer_ui_host C CXX ASM)
set(LV_CONF_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lv_conf.h" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(LV_CONF_BUILD_DISABLE_EXAMPLES ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LV_CONF_BUILD_DISABLE_DEMOS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LV_CONF_BUILD_DISABLE_THORVG_INTERNAL ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUFFER_UI_TEST_DPI "160" CACHE STRING "Logical display density for UI review")
add_compile_definitions(BUFFER_UI_TEST_BUILD)
add_compile_definitions(BUFFER_UI_TEST_DPI=${BUFFER_UI_TEST_DPI})
option(BUFFER_UI_REAL_FONTS "Render production Chinese typography" OFF)
if(BUFFER_UI_REAL_FONTS)
  add_compile_definitions(BUFFER_UI_REAL_FONTS)
  find_package(Freetype REQUIRED)
endif()
add_subdirectory("${VELA_SDK}/apps/graphics/lvgl/lvgl" lvgl-build)
if(BUFFER_UI_REAL_FONTS)
  target_link_libraries(lvgl PUBLIC Freetype::Freetype)
  set(BUFFER_UI_FONT_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../app/buffer_app/assets/fonts/MiSans-Regular.ttf" CACHE FILEPATH "Exact regular font bundled in the reviewed firmware")
  add_compile_definitions(CONFIG_BUFFER_VELA_FONT_PATH="${BUFFER_UI_FONT_FILE}")
endif()
get_filename_component(APP "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../app/buffer_app" ABSOLUTE)
add_executable(ui_host ui_host.c "${APP}/buffer_motion.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_motion.c" "${APP}/buffer_oobe_ui.c")
target_include_directories(ui_host PRIVATE "${APP}" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/graphics/lvgl" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/netutils/cjson/cJSON" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(ui_host PRIVATE lvgl m pthread)
target_compile_options(ui_host PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)

target_compile_options(lvgl PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
target_compile_options(ui_host PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
target_link_options(ui_host PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)

add_executable(record_host record_host.c)
target_include_directories(record_host PRIVATE "${APP}" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/graphics/lvgl" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(record_host PRIVATE lvgl m pthread)
target_compile_options(record_host PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
target_link_options(record_host PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)

add_executable(calendar_host calendar_host.c "${APP}/buffer_calendar.c" "${APP}/buffer_motion.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_motion.c" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/netutils/cjson/cJSON/cJSON.c")
file(GLOB BUFFER_ICAL_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${APP}/third_party/libical/*.c")
add_library(buffer_ical STATIC ${BUFFER_ICAL_SOURCES})
target_compile_definitions(buffer_ical PRIVATE HAVE_CONFIG_H)
target_include_directories(buffer_ical PUBLIC "${APP}/third_party/libical")
target_compile_options(buffer_ical PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
target_link_libraries(calendar_host PRIVATE buffer_ical)
target_include_directories(calendar_host PRIVATE "${APP}" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/graphics/lvgl" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/include" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_compile_definitions(calendar_host PRIVATE CONFIG_BUFFER_VELA_FABRIC CONFIG_BUFFER_VELA_DATA_DIR="${CALENDAR_TEST_DATA}")
target_compile_options(calendar_host PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
target_link_options(calendar_host PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)
target_link_libraries(calendar_host PRIVATE lvgl m pthread)

add_executable(oobe_host oobe_host.c "${APP}/buffer_motion.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_motion.c")
target_include_directories(oobe_host PRIVATE "${APP}" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/graphics/lvgl" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(oobe_host PRIVATE lvgl m pthread)
target_compile_options(oobe_host PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
target_link_options(oobe_host PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)

add_executable(home_host home_host.c "${APP}/buffer_motion.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_motion.c" "${APP}/buffer_oobe_ui.c")
target_include_directories(home_host PRIVATE "${APP}" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/graphics/lvgl" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/include" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_compile_definitions(home_host PRIVATE CONFIG_BUFFER_VELA_FOCUS_REMINDER_MS=1200000)
target_link_libraries(home_host PRIVATE lvgl m pthread)
target_compile_options(home_host PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-unused-parameter -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
target_link_options(home_host PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)
target_sources(home_host PRIVATE "${APP}/buffer_ui_preferences.c")
target_compile_definitions(home_host PRIVATE CONFIG_BUFFER_VELA_DATA_DIR="${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/home-state")

foreach(target ui_host record_host calendar_host oobe_host home_host)
  target_sources(${target} PRIVATE "${APP}/buffer_ui_layout.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_typography.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_icons.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_artwork.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_decor.c")
endforeach()

add_executable(g2d_fill_host g2d_fill_host.c)
target_include_directories(g2d_fill_host PRIVATE "${VELA_SDK}/apps/graphics/lvgl" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")

add_executable(g2d_image_host g2d_image_host.c)
target_include_directories(g2d_image_host PRIVATE "${VELA_SDK}/apps/graphics/lvgl" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(g2d_image_host PRIVATE lvgl m pthread)
target_compile_options(g2d_image_host PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-unused-parameter -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
target_link_options(g2d_image_host PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)

add_executable(shell_host shell_host.c "${APP}/buffer_ui_controls.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_decor.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_typography.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_shell.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_icons.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_layout.c" "${APP}/buffer_motion.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_motion.c")
target_include_directories(shell_host PRIVATE "${APP}" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/graphics/lvgl" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(shell_host PRIVATE lvgl m pthread)

foreach(target ui_host calendar_host oobe_host home_host)
  target_sources(${target} PRIVATE "${APP}/buffer_ui_shell.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_desktop.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_controls.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_notifications.c")
endforeach()

# Compile every production page with the device's Fabric-enabled branches.
# Executable fixtures above separately exercise behavior using controlled data.
add_library(ui_pages_compile OBJECT "${APP}/buffer_ui.c" "${APP}/buffer_a2ui_lvgl.c" "${APP}/buffer_calendar_ui.c" "${APP}/buffer_todo_ui.c" "${APP}/buffer_history_ui.c" "${APP}/buffer_oobe_ui.c")
target_include_directories(ui_pages_compile PRIVATE "${APP}" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/graphics/lvgl" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/netutils/cjson/cJSON" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/include" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_compile_definitions(ui_pages_compile PRIVATE CONFIG_BUFFER_VELA_FABRIC CONFIG_BUFFER_VELA_FOCUS_REMINDER_MS=1200000)
target_compile_options(ui_pages_compile PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
target_link_libraries(ui_pages_compile PRIVATE lvgl)

add_executable(typography_host typography_host.c "${APP}/buffer_ui_typography.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_controls.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_layout.c" "${APP}/buffer_motion.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_motion.c")
target_include_directories(typography_host PRIVATE "${APP}" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/graphics/lvgl" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(typography_host PRIVATE lvgl m pthread)
target_compile_options(typography_host PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
target_link_options(typography_host PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)

add_executable(notifications_host notifications_host.c "${APP}/buffer_ui_notifications.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_typography.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_layout.c" "${APP}/buffer_motion.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_motion.c")
target_include_directories(notifications_host PRIVATE "${APP}" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/graphics/lvgl" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(notifications_host PRIVATE lvgl m pthread)
target_compile_options(notifications_host PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
target_link_options(notifications_host PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)

add_executable(desktop_host desktop_host.c "${APP}/buffer_ui_desktop.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_typography.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_layout.c" "${APP}/buffer_motion.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_motion.c")
target_include_directories(desktop_host PRIVATE "${APP}" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/graphics/lvgl" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

target_link_options(desktop_host PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)

set(RECIPE_TEST_DATA "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/recipe-state" CACHE PATH "Isolated native recipe fixture data")
add_executable(recipe_host recipe_host.c recipe_model_host.c "${APP}/buffer_assistant.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_layout.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_typography.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_notifications.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_shell.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_icons.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_artwork.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_decor.c" "${APP}/buffer_motion.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_motion.c")
target_include_directories(recipe_host PRIVATE "${APP}" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/graphics/lvgl" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/include" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_compile_definitions(recipe_host PRIVATE CONFIG_BUFFER_VELA_DATA_DIR="${RECIPE_TEST_DATA}")
target_link_libraries(recipe_host PRIVATE lvgl m pthread)
target_compile_options(recipe_host PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
target_link_options(recipe_host PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)

add_executable(history_host history_host.c "${APP}/buffer_agent_store.c" "${APP}/buffer_source_envelope.c" "${APP}/buffer_crdt.c" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/netutils/cjson/cJSON/cJSON.c")
add_executable(members_host members_host.c)
foreach(target history_host members_host)
  target_sources(${target} PRIVATE "${APP}/buffer_ui_shell.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_layout.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_typography.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_icons.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_artwork.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_decor.c" "${APP}/buffer_motion.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_motion.c")
  target_include_directories(${target} PRIVATE "${APP}" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/include" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/graphics/lvgl" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/netutils/cjson/cJSON" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
  target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE lvgl m pthread)
  target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)
  target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections)
  target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE -Wl,--gc-sections)
endforeach()
target_compile_definitions(members_host PRIVATE CONFIG_BUFFER_VELA_FABRIC CONFIG_BUFFER_VELA_FOCUS_REMINDER_MS=1200000)

# Exercise the production runtime image lease binding, without fixture artwork.
add_executable(image_artwork_host image_artwork_host.c "${APP}/buffer_ui_artwork.c" "${APP}/buffer_ui_decor.c")
target_include_directories(image_artwork_host PRIVATE "${APP}" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/graphics/lvgl" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/include" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_compile_options(image_artwork_host PRIVATE -UBUFFER_UI_TEST_BUILD -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
target_link_options(image_artwork_host PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)
target_link_libraries(image_artwork_host PRIVATE lvgl m pthread)

add_executable(decor_host decor_host.c "${APP}/buffer_ui_decor.c")
target_include_directories(decor_host PRIVATE "${APP}" "${VELA_SDK}/apps/graphics/lvgl" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_compile_options(decor_host PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
target_link_options(decor_host PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)
target_link_libraries(decor_host PRIVATE lvgl m pthread)

foreach(target ui_host recipe_host)
 target_sources(${target} PRIVATE "${APP}/buffer_ui_recipe_state.c")
endforeach()

target_link_options(recipe_host PRIVATE -Wl,--wrap=buffer_assistant_restore_recipe)

target_compile_options(icons_host PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
